notes.title: New Update 12.09.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We completely changed the game fonts to more readable
[*] Fixed some bugs related to movement and cursor
[*] Fixed the display of the buttons and texts that they do not grow out of bounds
[*] And perhaps most importantly. is the addition of two new languages in the game: Chinese and Spanish
[/list]

notes.title: New update 0.9 ver
notes.content:
- Redesign bonuses 3d models
- Fixed problem with player icons in multiplayer
- Fixed a bug when the camera fell under ground
- Fixed a bug when several monsters took all lives
- Fixed a problem with displaying the map name in multiplayer
- Added a 3 second delay after pause in single player mode
- Added some animations to the interface
- Added 5 small maps to multiplayer
- Added one new big map to multiplayer
- Added random order for passing levels in single player mode
- Improved the tutorial
